answer: Attestation is a wager, not an opinion. To seal an answer a peer escrows 250 POA on a yes call that it settles passed; if the answer fails, that bond is forfeit and paid to peers who called it right. Seal weight follows each wager's calibration on a fable set of known outcomes, so a lucky guess earns near zero. Exposure is capped per funding root: a nebula of one hundred clones shares a single 1,000 POA ceiling, so a hundred bets from one harbor of shared funding count as one bet of 1,000. Faking four seals costs escrow that burns on failure, and each extra clone adds bond but no exposure.
